cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Flutter Developer to join our team.

cond_0371.intro: We are looking for a Flutter Developer to join our team.

Deliver results using .NET framework and C# for building scalable applications. Create Frameworks for cross-platform mobile development. Full SDLC - design, build, testing and release of working software. You will contribute to a continuous improvement environment, review code of team members, assist in adherence to development standards, guidelines and best practices agreed by the team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. Analyze the customer needs and design, document, test, and develop software as required to satisfy the functional and non-requirements. Provide technical expertise on aspects of the organization's IT infrastructure / software applications / architecture / hardware to internal customers, advise them of appropriate actions to fulfill procedural and regulatory requirements or solve immediate problems. Manage production support issues. Work with customers as required. Complete agreed work within established estimates and communicates status and issues promptly.

Expertise in WebAPI Framework, WCF and WS (Web Service) Extensions
Solid understanding of Azure Platform: Azure App Services and Azure Service Bus
Expertise in SQL Server, MySQL and MongoDB
Proficiency in Message Oriented Middleware, MSMQ and ESB
Strong command of Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure)
